name: Pinnant
ability: Keen Eye / Big Pecks / Cheek Pouch (hidden)
look: a red-brown bird with a white face and bib, a swept-back red crest, big grey eyes, a hooked yellow beak, half-open brown wings and two long black-and-grey banded tail streamers
entry: It trails its two long streamers like pennants as it flies between the crag and the berry bushes, bringing food back for the chicks. Flocks tell each other apart by the bands on their streamers.
how: Wild: uncommon at pinbird nests (rocky crags topped with a great hay nest, in plains, meadows, savannas and windswept hills).
